intervention: For each common-specialization-compatible class pair, recover the same simultaneous first-order unifier theta, specialize both source-law substitutions and both entire host terms coherently, retain the same structural path and source-law orientation, construct and replay-check the two existing-law contextual equalities, install only that pair into the frozen d=2 theorem state, and recompute closure/cross-distance.
ranking: No target-shaped ranking. Enumerate deterministically by existing class order, term order, interaction order, and common-specialization discovery order; deduplicate extensionally before isolation tests.

decision_table.PASS_CLOSURE: a replay-valid whole-context-specialized existing-law pair closes the theorem and ablation removes closure
decision_table.PASS_2_TO_1_CAUSAL: a replay-valid whole-context-specialized existing-law pair lowers d from 2 to at most 1 and ablation restores d=2
decision_table.WHOLE_CONTEXT_REPLAY_VALID_NO_CAUSAL_ATT: whole-context specialization compiles to replay-valid pairs but none contracts the real theorem cut under the frozen intervention bounds
decision_table.NO_REPLAYABLE_WHOLE_CONTEXT_PAIR: the parent whole-context replay rescue does not reproduce under the causal attack enumeration

scientific_rule: This is an ATTACK gate, not another representation test. Whole-context specialization earns no theorem-level credit unless installation changes the frozen real theorem geometry and ablation reverses that change. No new proof rule, operator family, target-derived selector, or post-hoc budget change is permitted.
